About Oscilar

Oscilar is building the Agentic Risk Platformâ¢ for banks and fintechs, reimagining how financial institutions manage fraud, credit risk, compliance and onboarding in the AI era.

Our platform brings decisioning, data and AI agents together in one system, so risk teams can make better decisions in real time and automate increasingly complex work. Agent Hub gives them 30+ specialized AI agents across fraud, AML, credit, onboarding, sanctions and disputes.

Oscilar is trusted by 100+ fintechs and financial institutions, including SoFi, MoneyGram and Nuvei, and makes tens of billions of risk decisions a year. ARR has grown 15x in the last 2 years.

Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, which went public at a valuation of about $10 billion and later agreed to be acquired by IBM for $11 billion.

The Role

We're hiring our first VP of Brand and Communications to lead Brand, PR and Communications and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

You'll own how Oscilar shows up in the market: the story we tell, the voice we tell it in, and where it gets heard. That means directing our PR to land Oscilar in Tier 1 publications and keep a steady drumbeat of coverage around every launch and milestone; defining a brand voice and guidelines that make us instantly recognizable as the agentic risk platform; launching brand campaigns that get financial services leaders talking; and turning our founder's industry profile into reach with the buyers we sell to.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy for brand, PR and comms, and personally get the first versions of the most important work out the door. You'll lead our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our PR agencies from day one, hire your first team member soon after joining, and build the team as results come in. You'll also build the playbook for an AI-native brand function, using agents and automation so a small team can do far more than its size suggests.

You'll report to Tomas Lobo, VP of Marketing and Growth, and work closely with our CEO and executive team, Product Marketing, Growth, Events and Design. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on Oscilar's growth and reputation.

What You'll Own

Brand Strategy & Category Leadership

  • Own Oscilar's brand strategy end to end, and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

  • Work with our founders to sharpen the agentic risk narrative, and turn it into a point of view the market repeats back to us.

  • Turn executive alignment into a cohesive brand voice and brand guidelines, and make sure the brand shows up consistently across the website, sales, content, social and events.

  • Evolve the brand as the company grows: new products, new markets and new audiences.

  • Own the brand budget and investment plan, and decide where each dollar builds the most awareness and trust.

  • Make sure Oscilar shows up in AI search and LLM answers, not just traditional search and media.

PR & Communications

  • Set the bar for what great PR looks like, and direct our agencies (including Highwire) to get there.

  • Land Oscilar's story in Tier 1 publications such as Fortune and the Wall Street Journal.

  • Build a steady drumbeat of earned media around product launches, customer stories, company milestones and timely news.

  • Build lasting relationships with the media, analysts and industry voices that shape our market.

  • Run PR as the long game it is, while making sure Oscilar shows up in today's conversations.

  • Own crisis communications readiness and the corporate narrative around major company moments.

  • Partner with People on our employer brand, so the story we tell the market also attracts great talent.

Social Strategy

  • Own Oscilar's social strategy across founder-led, executive-led, employee-led and company channels.

  • Make each channel amplify the others, so a single story travels from Neha to our executives, our employees and the company page.

  • Build an employee advocacy program that turns our team into a distribution channel.

  • Measure social by reach and engagement with the buyers we sell to, not vanity metrics.

Founder & Executive Presence

  • Manage Neha's presence across social media, video, media, podcasts and events, building on her 50K followers and her standing in the industry.

  • Own her roadmap of speaking, media and social moments, so she shows up in the right places at the right time.

  • Build the platforms that make Neha and our executives and experts the voices people seek out on AI, fraud, credit and compliance.

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Set the long-term content strategy that builds Oscilar's authority in AI and risk: original research, data assets, signature franchises and executive points of view.

  • Bring Product Marketing, PR and content together around one shared plan, so every launch and campaign tells part of the same story.

  • Build content that compounds over time and becomes the reference point for our industry.

Brand Campaigns & Programs

  • Launch fast, high-ROI brand campaigns alongside long-term programs. Our first is the Agents of Risk awards program.

  • Run several bets in parallel, set clear goals for each, measure results, and decide quickly what to scale or stop.

  • Turn what works into flagship programs, partnerships and experiences that become recognized across financial services.

Team & AI-Native Operations

  • Lead and grow our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our agency partners from day one.

  • Build the Brand, PR and Communications team over time, adding your first hire soon after joining and growing the function as results come in.

  • Build an AI-native function: automate brand, PR and social workstreams with agents so a small team can do far more.

  • Define the function's priorities, operating rhythm and how we measure brand impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You've set the brand and PR strategy, are directing our agencies with a clear point of view, and have early wins on the board: earned media around our launches, a brand voice the company has adopted, and the first brand campaigns live and measured.

  • First year: Oscilar is recognized as the defining name in agentic risk. We have Tier 1 coverage and a steady drumbeat of earned media, a social presence that reaches the buyers we sell to across founder, executive, employee and company channels, and flagship programs the industry looks forward to.

  • Long term: You've built a high-performing, AI-native Brand, PR and Communications team, and brand has become one of Oscilar's biggest competitive advantages.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in brand, PR and communications, including leading brand and PR or comms at VP or Head-of level at a successful, sales-led B2B SaaS company.

  • Deep PR judgment. You've directed agencies to Tier 1 coverage and know what great looks like.

  • You've built a brand voice and guidelines that teams actually used, and you can take a messy draft and make it sharp.

  • You've run fast, measurable brand campaigns alongside long-term programs.

  • You're a hands-on player-coach: proactive, responsive, and quick to ship rather than theorize.

  • You're AI-native and have automated real marketing work with AI tools or agents.

  • You've managed experienced people and agencies, and aligned teams such as PMM and content on one plan.

  • You've owned a brand budget and managed creative teams and agencies across PR, design and video.

  • Clear, concise communication and strong creative instincts.

Bonus Experience

  • Selling to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, security or other risk and trust buyers.

  • Running a founder-led social program, especially for a technical founder.

  • Launching an awards program or other industry-recognition campaign.

  • Building a brand or comms function from scratch, or leading through a major moment such as an IPO or large announcement.

Why This Role Is Unique

  • Build from scratch, without the typical startup risk. You'll build Oscilar's brand function from the ground up at a company that already has product-market fit and has grown ARR 15x in 2 years.

  • A proven, second-time founder. Work directly with Neha Narkhede, who co-created Apache Kafka and co-founded Confluent, taking it to a roughly $10 billion IPO and an $11 billion acquisition agreement with IBM.

  • A manager who has done this before. Tomas Lobo helped build Samsara from $1M to close to $500M in ARR in about 5 years.

  • A category to name. Help define agentic risk, a new category at the intersection of AI, risk and financial infrastructure.

  • Room to build. A VP title, a seat with the founders, a PR partner already in place, and room to hire and build your team.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan.

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture.

  • Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents. (US)

  • Balance: Unlimited PTO policy.

  • Culture: Family-friendly environment; regular team events and offsites.

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Impact: Help make the internet safer by protecting online transactions and building the infrastructure powering the future of financial risk.

Loopio is on the hunt for a Senior Software Developer with an AI engineering background who thrives on solving complex problems and is driven by curiosity. If you have taken LLM-based systems from idea to production and want your work to help leading organizations respond to RFPs faster and with more confidence, this is the role for you. Youâll join a team of Engineers, ML practitioners, Product Managers, and Designers to design and ship AI-powered features, from agentic workflows that reason over long and messy documents to the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. At Loopio, we value clean code, evidence-driven decisions, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. From shaping technical direction to mentoring teammates, youâll play a key role in scaling our systems and evolving our product. Weâre deeply collaborative. Whether itâs pair programming, technical design reviews, error-analysis sessions, or whiteboarding ideas, we believe the best solutions are built together. If youâre excited by owning problems from zero, letting evidence drive your decisions, and leaving things better than you found them, letâs build the future together. Note: This is an existing vacancy on the team What Youâll Be Doing: Owning problems end to end, from zero. You take an idea or problem through framing, a research plan, build, validation, shipping, and monitoring, and you make fast, honest pursue-or-kill calls along the way. Designing, building, and shipping LLM-based and agentic systems (tool use, multi-step workflows) that plan and execute work over long or messy documents, including layout-aware parsing, extraction, classification, and cross-document reasoning. Partnering closely with the ML team to turn research prototypes into reliable, maintainable features in a shared codebase with a proper test harness and CI workflow, including knowledge-graph-grounded retrieval where it fits. Building evaluation into everything you ship: eval sets and regression suites, at both the task level and the step level, that predict production behavior for single models and multi-step pipelines alike. Digging into the data before modeling, and running systematic error analysis when results fall short. You judge whether a problem demands precision, recall, or coverage, because a missed question costs the customer and a wrong suggestion costs trust. Going below the API when it makes sense: training, fine-tuning, or distilling models, and surveying the research literature to adapt what you find to the problem at hand. Operating AI features live, including tracing, failure triage, and managing cost and latency tradeoffs. Contributing to Loopioâs AI roadmap by evaluating third-party models, establishing patterns for agentic workflows, and defining technical and evaluation guidelines for AI-powered features. Designing and shipping reusable frameworks and shared libraries that raise the bar for how every team at Loopio builds, so good patterns scale instead of being reinvented. Interacting with and gathering detailed feedback from our customers, because you understand that creating a user-centric experience comes first. Explaining tradeoffs, metrics, and failure modes to product and engineering partners in plain language, with write-ups that let others follow your reasoning and act on your results. Mentoring and coaching others, providing technical guidance and helping build an environment of knowledge-sharing and encouraging feedback. Comfortably leading technical design discussions and facilitating technical decision making. Experience as a technical lead is a bonus! What Youâll Bring To The Team: 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software systems at scale. Experience shipping LLM-based systems to production, including hands-on work with agentic pipelines (tool use, multi-step workflows) and modern AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude). Solid ML and NLP fundamentals: model training and fine-tuning, embeddings and transformer architectures, and the statistics to trust an experiment. Experience applying NLP to messy real-world documents: parsing, chunking, extraction, and classification. Rigor in research and evaluation. You look at the data before modeling, let evidence drive decisions, run systematic error analysis when results fall short, and build eval sets and regression suites that predict production behavior. The ability to own problems end to end, from zero, and to make fast, honest pursue-or-kill calls. Comfort surveying research literature and adapting what you find to the problem at hand. We help brokers, MGAs, and carriers extract insights, automate workflows, and move faster by turning unstructured data into action. Our customer base is growing quickly, and we're looking for a Customer Success Manager with commercial insurance experience to help us scale. This person will be a strategic partner to our customers and an important internal voice as we keep building our product and go-to-market approach. About the Role We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own the post-sale customer journey for a portfolio of agency, broker, and carrier accounts. You'll report to the Head of Customer Success and work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partnering with customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion. This is a high-impact role for someone who understands how commercial insurance agencies operate and enjoys building in a fast-moving environment. You'll work directly with agency leaders, producers, and account teams to drive adoption, deepen relationships, and help shape how we scale customer success as the business grows. If you're energized by ownership, close customer partnership, and helping define the playbook as a company grows, you'll likely thrive here. Why This Role Join a company with strong customer momentum and a lot of opportunity ahead. Work closely with the Head of Customer Success and CRO on customer growth, retention, and expansion strategy. Own the customer experience end to end, from onboarding and activation through renewal and upsell. Help shape the product roadmap by being a direct voice of the customer. Join a high-caliber team built from Meta, IBM, Adobe, Salesforce, DocuSign, and Uber, with real ownership, strong trust, and meaningful equity. What You'll Do Own onboarding and activation for agencies, brokers, and carriers using the Outmarket platform, so customers see value fast and adopt the product widely. Build and maintain trusted relationships with agency principals, department leaders, producers, and account managers. Be the main post-sale contact for implementation, training, ongoing engagement, retention, and account health. Find expansion opportunities in existing accounts, whether that's new teams, new lines of business, or new use cases. Turn customer feedback into product insights that help set roadmap priorities. Use AI tools like Claude every day to prep for customer conversations, analyze account health, build content, and scale yourself across a growing book of accounts. Build and improve onboarding materials, training content, and Customer Success processes that can scale with the business. What We're Looking For 4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation, ideally at a B2B SaaS company. AI fluency is a must. We're an AI company, and our best CSMs use AI tools like Claude every day to work smarter. You either already do this, or you're eager to learn everything you can and put it to work right away. Hands-on experience in commercial insurance, whether at an agency, brokerage, MGA, carrier, or an insurtech selling to them. You know how agencies are structured, how account teams work day to day, and what drives renewals. A track record of owning a book of accounts and moving the numbers that matter: adoption, retention, and expansion. Comfort leading onboarding and training for users ranging from agency principals to day-to-day account managers. Strong communication skills. You can run an executive business review in the morning and a hands-on training in the afternoon. The ability to spot patterns across customers and turn them into clear, useful feedback for Product. A builder's mindset. You like creating playbooks, templates, and processes where none exist yet. Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. You take ownership without waiting for direction. Nice to have Experience across multiple lines of business (P&C, Employee Benefits, specialty). Familiarity with agency management systems (e.g. Applied Epic, Vertafore AMS360) or other tools agencies rely on. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup. title: Senior iOS Engineer, Foundations
description: We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join Raya Foundations, the platform team that owns the shared foundation every other Raya engineering team builds on. On the client side that means the architecture of our iOS codebase, its modularization and build system, shared libraries and design-system components, CI and release tooling, crash and performance infrastructure, and the AI-collaborative development tooling our iOS engineers use every day. This is a senior client engineering role with deep technical impact across a large, long-lived swift iOS codebase. The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app. We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity. Responsibilities Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams. Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally. Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling). Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client. Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app. Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns. Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs. Requirements 5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM. Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns. A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience. Experience owning client platform or infrastructure work that other engineers depend on (modularizing a large iOS codebase, build and CI systems, shared libraries, design systems, or release tooling) and driving its adoption. Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balance speed and quality, and own what you ship after it ships. You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness. What Sets You Apart Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus! Experience with Xcode build performance, Swift Package Manager or Bazel/Tuist, and CI/CD for iOS at scale. Has built developer tooling, agents, or evals that other engineers adopted: code review agents, lint and architecture rules, test generation, or LLM-powered dev harnesses. Occasional comfort or interest in shipping production backend code (Node.js/TypeScript) alongside the client, and designing the APIs mobile clients depend on. Experience with mobile security: device trust, certificate pinning, secrets handling, or security remediation on the client. Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs Strong troubleshooting instincts. Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders. Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support. Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations. Background in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus. Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners. Exposure to ISV/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations. Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners. Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. As Adunaâs voice in the developer community, youâll bring network APIs closer to developers and turn awareness into real adoption. Youâll grow and engage developer audiences across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and independent communities including GitHub, Stack Overflow, YouTube and Discord, using technical content, events, demos and hands-on engagement to take developers from curiosity to their first successful API call. Build and publish sample apps, starter kits and tutorials on GitHub that developers actually use and star. You will manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to negotiation and contract closure, focusing on large enterprise customers. Combining software, professional services, and support solutions, you will help organizations address complex data challenges and achieve measurable business outcomes. You will build trusted relationships with senior industry executives, customers, and strategic partners while identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts. Working closely with Marketing, Presales, and Consulting teams, you will develop a sustainable sales pipeline and deliver against ambitious revenue targets. This is a fully remote opportunity offering autonomy, professional growth, and the chance to contribute to a collaborative, innovation-driven environment. Accountabilities: Develop and execute a comprehensive territory sales strategy focused on acquiring new enterprise customers, expanding existing accounts, and consistently achieving revenue objectives. Manage complex, consultative sales cycles while positioning integrated software, services, and support solutions that address customers' business and data management needs. Identify, prospect, develop, and close new business opportunities while maintaining strong customer satisfaction and building referenceable client relationships. Sell integrated software, professional services, and support solutions to drive customer success and long-term value. Manage assigned territories strategically by targeting key accounts and collaborating with selected partners to generate additional pipeline opportunities. Lead complex, enterprise-wide sales cycles and effectively communicate the value proposition to senior decision-makers. Collaborate with Marketing to develop territory strategies and target account plans, building a healthy rolling four-quarter pipeline. Coordinate team-selling activities with Presales and Consulting Services to deliver comprehensive customer solutions. Identify opportunities to acquire new customers and expand business within existing accounts in competitive markets. Build and maintain relationships with senior industry executives, enterprise customers, strategic partners, and system integrators. Develop in-depth knowledge of products, customer accounts, competitors, and industry trends, particularly across Data Migration, Master Data Management, Data Quality, and Data Governance. Understand customer requirements, industry-specific challenges, business priorities, operational constraints, and evolving market conditions. Leverage executive support and partner leadership engagement to advance sales strategies and resolve field-level challenges. Manage sales activities against quarterly and annual targets, consistently working to achieve and exceed assigned quotas. Maintain accurate pipeline records, forecast revenue, and track sales activities using Salesforce. Participate in individual and team meetings, training sessions, and industry conferences. Travel as required to support customer relationships and business development activities. You are also a collaborative team player who embraces continuous learning, accountability, innovation, and shared success. Ideally 7+ years of proven direct and/or indirect sales experience, preferably selling software and professional services to large enterprise customers. Experience with the Sandler sales methodology or comparable structured sales frameworks is preferred. Demonstrated expertise in territory and pipeline management, including prospecting, opportunity development, deal orchestration, and closing complex sales cycles. Strong background in value-based and solutions-oriented selling. Established relationships with industry decision-makers, enterprise customers, strategic partners, SAP partners, and system integrators. Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales objectives, with achievements such as President's Club or Sales Representative of the Year recognition preferred. Highly driven, ambitious, and motivated by achieving challenging business objectives. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize activities, manage resources effectively, and qualify opportunities strategically. Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
description: Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom. Â Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. Weâre empowering organizations to secure their softwareâno matter how the code is written! We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition. This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters. What you'll do Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask. Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick. Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer. Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new. Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster. Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't. Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions. Who you are A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page. A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down. Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't. Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place. Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later. Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better. What you bring 6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company 3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari Nice to have Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience A background as a sales engineer or seller Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function Why you'll like it here Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly. A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself. Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows. A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it. Location This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events. You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters. We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you. You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior. We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same. Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives. Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development. title: Sales Enablement Director
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Enablement Director based in the United Kingdom. We are looking for an experienced Sales Enablement Director to drive sales excellence and strengthen the performance of enterprise revenue teams in a fast-growing cybersecurity environment. This senior individual-contributor role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, providing direct coaching and practical guidance to sales professionals, sales engineers, partners, and managers. You will design and deliver impactful enablement programs, improve onboarding and continuous learning, and equip teams with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. Working closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations, you will help align go-to-market strategies and strengthen commercial execution. You will also leverage AI-powered technologies and data-driven insights to measure performance, improve sales readiness, and accelerate productivity. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a highly technical industry dedicated to protecting critical infrastructure and connected environments worldwide. Accountabilities Provide strategic and hands-on coaching to sales representatives, sales engineers, partners, and managers to improve sales execution, strengthen performance, and accelerate revenue growth. Design, implement, and manage role-specific enablement programs, including onboarding, certification, continuous learning, career development, and skills advancement initiatives. Develop and maintain sales enablement resources, including playbooks, battlecards, messaging frameworks, talk tracks, discovery guides, objection-handling materials, and best-practice documentation. Drive sales readiness and execution excellence by reinforcing consistent sales methodologies, improving field capabilities, and supporting successful sales motions. Monitor enablement effectiveness through adoption rates, proficiency assessments, readiness indicators, and sales performance metrics, translating insights into continuous program improvements. Optimize the use of modern enablement technologies, including AI-powered coaching tools, conversation intelligence platforms, learning management systems (LMS), CRM solutions, and content management systems. Lead change management initiatives to encourage the adoption of new sales methodologies, processes, tools, messaging, and collaborative selling practices. Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue leadership to support product launches, competitive positioning, go-to-market initiatives, and evolving market opportunities. Requirements: 8â10 years of proven experience in sales enablement, supporting quota-carrying enterprise and/or commercial sales teams within complex B2B technology environments. Strong understanding of sales methodologies, revenue operations, enterprise sales processes, and the challenges associated with technically complex sales cycles. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering onboarding, continuous learning, skills assessments, certification, and professional development programs. Proven ability to coach and develop sales professionals through live customer calls, active opportunities, deal reviews, role-playing exercises, and other practical learning approaches. Experience supporting technical sales teams, including Sales Engineers, Solutions Consultants, presales professionals, and other customer-facing technical roles. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to measure program adoption, sales readiness, behavioral change, and business impact through relevant performance indicators. Excellent facilitation, coaching, presentation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives. Ability to create clear, concise, and practical sales resources, including playbooks, discovery frameworks, competitive guidance, messaging, talk tracks, and objection-handling materials. Familiarity with modern sales enablement technologies, CRM platforms, learning management systems, AI-powered coaching solutions, conversation intelligence, and content management tools. Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage organizational change, and drive alignment across distributed teams. Experience in cybersecurity, Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), IoT security, critical infrastructure, industrial technology, cloud security, or other complex enterprise software sectors is highly desirable. A proactive, adaptable, and hands-on approach, with the ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across a global organization. Financial benefits and support designed to promote long-term employee well-being. Flexible working arrangements that support work-life balance. Unparalleled flexible time-off policy. title: Knowledge Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Knowledge Engineer based in the United States. The Knowledge Engineer will play a pivotal role in building the knowledge infrastructure and AI-powered systems that support business operations and customer experiences. In this role, you will design and maintain trusted knowledge repositories, intelligent AI agents, and automated workflows that help teams access accurate information and streamline everyday tasks. Working across departments such as Support, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Engineering, you will transform fragmented business knowledge into structured, AI-accessible resources. You will also develop secure integrations and intelligent automation solutions that enable AI systems to perform routine activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight. By combining expertise in AI engineering, data architecture, and knowledge management, you will help establish scalable and reliable AI capabilities across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an AI-first transformation within a collaborative, technology-driven environment. Accountabilities: Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Consolidate and organize knowledge from multiple platforms, including Google Drive, Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, HubSpot, Zendesk, Highspot, and Slack, ensuring that each source has clear ownership and scheduled review dates. Collaborate with Data and Business Insights teams to make existing business data AI-ready by providing curated, read-only Snowflake views and standardized metric definitions that align with established reporting systems. Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows for business functions such as customer support ticket triage, renewal research, accounts payable processing, and software reviews. Develop and manage connectors, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and automation integrations that allow AI agents to interact securely with business systems while enforcing appropriate permissions, human approvals, and audit trails. Create automated pipelines that identify changes in documentation, business systems, and operational processes, ensuring that knowledge repositories, AI agents, and workflows remain accurate and up to date. Structure and optimize information for AI retrieval through taxonomy development, metadata management, content chunking, tagging, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Establish evaluation frameworks and quality assurance processes to measure AI agent accuracy, detect outdated or conflicting information, and minimize hallucinations before and after deployment. Maintain a centralized registry of approved AI connectors, prompts, plugins, reusable skills, and workflows to ensure that AI solutions remain secure, standardized, and company-owned. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Document technical architecture, workflows, integration standards, and operational processes while staying informed about emerging AI technologies and industry best practices. Monitor AI usage, operational costs, adoption, and feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve answer quality, and prioritize future enhancements. Partner with subject-matter experts across Support, Customer Success, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Product, and Engineering to capture institutional knowledge, map business processes, and establish content ownership. Collaborate with training teams, Product Marketing, and departmental AI champions to transform product documentation, customer support resources, and training materials into AI-accessible knowledge for internal teams and external customers. Integrate AI-powered tools into employee and customer training programs to improve knowledge sharing, self-service capabilities, and operational efficiency. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 5 years of experience in knowledge engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, solutions engineering, or technical knowledge management. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time. Benefits: Full-time remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to a company-wide AI transformation and help establish the foundations of an AI-first operating model. High-impact technical role with the opportunity to design and implement production AI agents and intelligent automation workflows. Exposure to modern AI technologies, including large language models, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP, and advanced data integration solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, data, finance, product, and customer-facing teams. Opportunity to develop and implement innovative solutions that improve employee productivity and customer experiences. Significant ownership and influence over AI architecture, knowledge management standards, and automation strategy. Professional development opportunities through continuous exposure to emerging AI tools, technologies, and practices. description: Role Description As an Â Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them. This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox. Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here . Responsibilities Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges. Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths. Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox. Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated. Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques. Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting. Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. Requirements 5 + years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability. A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities. Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries. Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures . Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies. Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities. Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks. Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments. Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques. Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring. description: Reddit is a community of communities. Itâs built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities create rich and complex data, and we build tools that help people turn that data into reliable understanding. The Data Science Platform team develops Rosso, Redditâs analytics agent, and the shared tools that support analytical and scientific work across the company. We are looking for software engineers who enjoy building AI systems that people can depend on: useful workflows, clear interfaces, thoughtful evals, and software that improves through production experience. In this role, you will own a substantial part of our agent and scientific-tooling platform. Experience designing and using evals to improve AI systems: representative cases, baselines, failure analysis, grader limitations, and quality criteria that influence what ships. Practical experience with service reliability, authorization, queues or asynchronous execution, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and operational monitoring. Working fluency in SQL and experience integrating data-intensive services or analytical tools; an ability to preserve data provenance and documented analytical constraints. A record of leading substantial technical work with other engineers and partner teams, explaining tradeoffs clearly, and helping others contribute effectively. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred qualifications Experience with analytics agents, text-to-SQL, data discovery, notebook or code-execution environments, or internal platforms for data scientists. Experience with agent evaluation harnesses, tool protocols such as MCP, model gateways, retrieval systems, or secure sandboxed execution. Experience building reusable scientific libraries, packaging statistical methods behind stable APIs, or collaborating closely with scientists on validation. Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and large-scale analytical data systems such as BigQuery, Trino, Spark, or Airflow. Experience building product interfaces in TypeScript or React, or improving developer experience and adoption for a shared platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role.
